description: This file contains unit tests for the EducationDao class within the OrangeHRM system, specifically testing database interactions related to Education entities such as adding, editing, deleting, and retrieving education records.

classes.name: EducationDaoTest
classes.description: Unit test class for testing the EducationDao data access object, covering CRUD operations and validation methods related to Education entities.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, creating an instance of EducationDao and populating test data from fixtures.

methods.name: testAddEducation
methods.description: Tests the functionality of saving a new Education record.

methods.name: testEditEducation
methods.description: Tests updating an existing Education record.

methods.name: testGetEducationById
methods.description: Tests retrieving an Education record by its ID.

methods.name: testGetEducationList
methods.description: Tests fetching a list of Education records based on filter parameters.

methods.name: testDeleteEducations
methods.description: Tests deleting multiple Education records by IDs.

methods.name: testDeleteWrongRecord
methods.description: Tests attempting to delete non-existent Education records.

methods.name: testIsExistingEducationName
methods.description: Tests checking existence of Education by name with different casing and whitespace.

methods.name: testGetEducationByName
methods.description: Tests fetching Education entities by their name, including handling of variations in case and whitespace.
